assets.name: AeroSandbox.rosella.json
assets.role: Rosella model file and sizing result H4_12S

model_description.description: AeroSandbox combined stability job (2026-11-27), model file sha256 a0ce7b226b6f

notes: Roll-up of the 44 point masses of the H4_12S sizing result (mass_model.rollup). The sizing owns the mass model until a SpecSheet exists (ADR 0022).
Own inertia added for tail_boom, fuselage, battery and the two lift booms (the rules of model.QuadplaneModel). Every other item is a point mass.
The sizing result gives Ixx 3.2341, Iyy 4.1351, Izz 7.3382 kg m^2. Its Ixx is about y = 0 and z = 0, not about the CG height. This roll-up is about the CG.
The sizing CG x is -0.138996 m (FRD: the static margin target ahead of the neutral point).
No uncertainty estimate exists in the source (sigma not given).
Placeholder: the stall values, the nacelle and stopped-propeller drag areas and the mass model are stand-ins.
Method combined. Trim point of the cruise_trim job (AeroBuildup of the tree): V 18.8445 m/s, alpha 0.0526 deg, elevator 2.1999 deg.
Trim check: the method has the CL and Cm of that trim at alpha 1.4373 deg and elevator 6.7144 deg. The difference is the gap between the two methods.

Limits: no propeller slipstream. AeroBuildup gives the bodies no rate effect. The combined method has the inviscid lifting-surface CL0 of the vortex lattice (no viscous lift loss). Aileron and rudder are 0 at the trim.
CD0 and K come from the AeroBuildup polar, not from the method of the derivatives.

assets.name: propulsion.rosella_lift_bemt
assets.role: BEMT samples of the scaled lift blade

model_description.description: CT and CP samples of the lift blade at the scales and shaft speeds of the sizing table (hover and 2.5 m/s climb)

notes: Sea-level density 1.225 kg/m3. CT = T/(rho n^2 D^4), CP = Q omega/(rho n^3 D^5), n in rev/s, D = 2 R_ref scale. A scaled copy of a measured blade: a model value, not a measurement.
Not the Aerolink propulsion table (no throttle map): the dataset role is other.
